greet.text: A small woman, shorter than your elbow, with flour to hers. "Lanternfast! The lanterns are because it's a party, whatever the big folk tell you. Here. You look like you've been fighting something."

choices.text: What do your people say the lanterns are for?

again.text: "Only one each! I've counted. Twice." Hettie Kettlewick guards her tins like a dragon.

choices.text: What do your people say the lanterns are for?

why.text: "For? For seeing the cake." She winks. "My old gran played cards with somebody who said the other thing. Never told me what. Said I'd laugh."
